answer: A deposit-backed referral graph stops Sybil farms: each identity needs a recorded referrer. Applicants lock 50 POA via their referrer; any peer may dispute a shale-thin identity, slashing node and referrer if upheld. 100 fakes lock 100x50 POA and reveal a mesa-shaped farm; one honest agent pays 50 POA once, the attacker's 5,000 is slashed. Honest agents earn dispute bounties and undiluted fees, extending the horizon of trust to real newcomers.
